bias.en: Bullish turn · pressing the top of the range
bias.zh: 转强 · 挑战区间上沿

read.en: Amazon eased 1.1% on Oct 12 to $259.53 after touching $263.70, but is up 3% over five sessions and sits above all its averages. The 30 and 100-day averages have converged near $253, and the 200-day ($242) is rising. MACD has been above its signal since Oct 5 with a growing histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 2 ($249), and RSI is 56.
read.zh: 亚马逊 10月12日盘中触及 $263.70 后回落 1.1%，收于 $259.53，但五个交易日累计上涨 3%，股价位于全部均线上方。30 日和 100 日均线在约 $253 处汇合，200 日均线（$242）向上。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线上方且柱体放大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月2日起看多（$249），RSI 为 56。

read.en: Price is testing the top of its September–October range. A close above the Oct 12 high of $263.70 would target $267.60 (Aug 28 high), then $287 (Aug 3 high). Support is $257 (tested four times in September), then the 30 and 100-day averages near $253 and the range floor at $244–249.
read.zh: 股价正测试 9–10 月区间上沿。若收盘站上 10月12日高点 $263.70，目标看 $267.60（8月28日高点），再看 $287（8月3日高点）。支撑为 $257（9月四次测试），其次约 $253 的 30 日与 100 日均线，以及 $244–249 的区间底部。

r.en: Oct 12 high, top of the Sep–Oct range
